title: Weldon Valley Schools
subtitle: Washington, D.C. January 18-21, 2029
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Weldon Valley Schools. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & National Archives 

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Welcome to Washington, D.C.! Meet your Landmark Leader at Baggage Claim
  • Food Trucks Allocation for Lunch
  • Visit National Archives
  • Group Exploration of Smithsonian Museums
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
  

Day 2: United States Capitol Building Tour & National Museum of American History

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the United States Capitol Building
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit
  • Meet and Greet with Representative or Senator at Capitol Hill
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: Presidential Inauguration & Ford’s Theater

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Ford’s Theater, Petersen House, and Aftermath Exhibits
  • Presidential Inauguration 
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 

Day 4: Arlington National Cemetery & Departure

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery 
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Weldon Valley Schools, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2029! 🏛️
introText: From historic landmarks to the heart of American government, this Washington, D.C. experience brings history to life at every turn. Students will explore iconic sites like the U.S. Capitol, Library of Congress, and National Archives, reflect at powerful memorials along the National Mall, and discover world-class exhibits throughout the Smithsonian museums. A highlight of the trip includes witnessing a Presidential Inauguration, offering a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to experience democracy in action. With meaningful learning moments and unforgettable sights, this trip is the perfect blend of education, culture, and excitement—an experience your students will never forget!
